challenge: Rare Disease, Real Kid: The MVA Hackathon 2026

features.name: Environment and data acquisition
features.description: uv project, gated HF dataset downloaded to data/ and size-verified against the remote tree, no-data-in-git gate wired as pre-commit hook.
features.evidence: ./init.sh 2026-08-26: 'COMPLETE: all files present at expected size', 84.99 GB / 11 files verified against the remote HF tree; no-data-in-git gate passes; pre-commit hook active.

features.name: Phenotype to HPO terms
features.description: Extract the clinical narrative from Challenge_Clinical_Phenotype_1.docx into a tracked, de-identified HPO term list in notes/phenotype.md for downstream ranking tools (Exomiser/LIRICAL style).

features.name: VCF triage baseline
features.description: Annotate the provided joint VCF (VEP or similar), filter to rare coding/splice variants, and produce a first candidate table. Establishes the reproducible baseline every later ranking is compared against.

features.name: Mosaicism and aneuploidy analysis from FASTQ
features.description: MVA is defined by mosaic aneuploidy, which a germline-only VCF will under-report. Realign the 8 FASTQ lanes and run mosaic-aware SNV calling plus CNV/aneuploidy detection, so low-VAF and structural findings are recoverable. GPU-eligible.

features.name: Track 1 submission
features.description: Ranked variant CSV matching static/templates/track1_submission_template.csv (proband_id, chrom/pos/ref/alt per allele, epcr, finding_type), plus methods writeup. Scored on rank points and F-max. Limit 6 submissions.

features.name: Track 2 drug repurposing report
features.description: Mechanism characterization for the top variant(s) and approved-drug candidates targeting the disrupted pathway, with report, public GitHub link, and 3-minute pitch video. Judged on rigor 35 / impact 25 / innovation 25 / scalability 15. Limit 1 submission.

features.name: Data deletion and confirmation
features.description: After close, delete data/, results/, logs/ and every derived copy, then email RarediseaserealkidMVAhackathon2026@synapse.org. Contractual obligation, due 2026-11-24.
